# BLOP (Mike Rawes' bandlimited oscillators and their companions), vendored

Source: BLOP 0.2.8, as Debian archives it (`blop_0.2.8.orig.tar.gz` from
<http://deb.debian.org/debian/pool/main/b/blop/>, sha256
`7e87134fac428d2c3a44423119e273d189ef08ee35f4873d7d88d64610af3e0a`; the
SourceForge downloads are gone), GPL version 2 or later: `COPYING`, `AUTHORS`
and the rest are upstream's.

## Why it is in the tree, and for how long

Old SSM patches use it: one family of songs is built from BLOP's oscillators,
envelopes, sums and products, sequencer and clock, 19 plugins between IDs 1641
and 1680, and without them those patches have no sound.

The private tree is porting BLOP to native devices, and once those reach this
one this directory can go: a patch that names a BLOP plugin by its LADSPA ID
would then load the native device instead. Until then these are built and
installed with the swh-plugins and CMT, under the application's own plugin
directory (`<plugins>/ladspa`), and skipped with them by
`--disable-bundled-ladspa`.

## What was changed

Nothing in the sources. Upstream's autoconf files, `Makefile.am`s and
translations are not vendored; `Makefile.am` here builds the same modules
under the same file names. Three things upstream's build did are done
differently:

- Each module sets itself up in `_init()` and tears down in `_fini()`, which
  upstream links with `-nostartfiles` so that they replace the C runtime's. A
  libtool module keeps the runtime's, and macOS never calls `_init`, so the
  build renames them and `blop-init.c` runs them as the module's constructor
  and destructor. The wavetable modules fill in their tables in an `_init()`
  of their own, with no `_fini()`, and `blop-data-init.c` runs it.
- `PACKAGE`, `LOCALEDIR`, `WAVEDATA_SUBDIR` and the `HAVE_` macros for
  `lrint`, `lrintf` and `sinf` come from `AM_CPPFLAGS`, and `config.h` here
  stands in for the one upstream's configure wrote. NLS is off, so gettext is
  a no-op.
- The oscillators' wavetables (sawtooth, square, parabola) are generated by
  upstream's `wavegen` at build time with its default settings, and installed
  in `<plugins>/ladspa/blop_files`, where the oscillators look for them: the
  host always puts its own plugin directory on `LADSPA_PATH`.

## What is not built

The three quantisers (`quantiser20_2027`, `quantiser50_2028`,
`quantiser100_2029`): upstream builds them with `-O0` ("-O1 or greater will
cause quantiser to fail"), which a target here cannot force over the user's
`CFLAGS`. No patch we have uses them, and the private tree's native quantiser
replaces them. Their source is kept.
